_comment: Host-authored synthetic cases. Each case replaces the single /* CASE */ marker of fixtures/synthetic/page.tsx with code, after expanding PATCH_FETCH and POST_FETCH to the literal fetch calls. accept: the public final and invariant checks both pass. reject: both report exactly one profile failure containing unchecked_reason. d2 names the Issue #899 D2 item a reject case covers. fallback_trap marks a case the old textual fallback (return prefix, `).ok` suffix or assigned `name.ok`) accepts, so it fails if an Unconfirmed chain falls back.
unchecked_reason: /api/bookmarks used by src/app/page.tsx does not check Response.ok before accepting the mutation
